guards.name: before_release
guards.message: Only a submitted or reviewed deliverable can return to Recorded.

guards.name: recorded

guards.name: active_request

guards.name: still_requested
guards.message: The material must still be on the request, or be an aliquot or sample of it.

signatures.label: Authorship
signatures.statement: I recorded this deliverable and its evidence.

guards.name: submitted
guards.message: Review the deliverable after its analyst submits it.

guards.name: independent_review
guards.check: history.review[0].by != actor.person && last.review.submitted.by != actor.person && edits.review.recorded.all(e, e.by != actor.person)
guards.message: Have a reviewer who did not create, submit or edit the deliverable sign it.

guards.name: active_request
guards.message: Sign the deliverable while the request is open and in progress at the service.

guards.name: still_requested
guards.message: The material must still be on the request, or be an aliquot or sample of it.

signatures.label: Review
signatures.statement: I reviewed the delivery report, outcome, and supporting evidence.

guards.name: reviewed
guards.message: Release the submitted deliverable after its independent review.

guards.name: independent_release
guards.check: history.review[0].by != actor.person && last.review.submitted.by != actor.person && last.review.reviewed.by != actor.person && edits.review.recorded.all(e, e.by != actor.person)
guards.message: Have someone in QA who did not create, submit, edit or review the deliverable release it.

guards.name: active_request
guards.message: Sign the deliverable while the request is open and in progress at the service.

guards.name: still_requested
guards.message: The material must still be on the request, or be an aliquot or sample of it.

signatures.label: QA release
signatures.statement: I release the independently reviewed deliverable to the requesting project.

states.name: withdrawn
states.label: Withdrawn
states.description: The project no longer needs it; the service stops work on it.

states.name: submitted
states.label: Submitted
states.description: Sent, and waiting for the service.

states.name: accepted
states.label: Accepted
states.description: The service will do it, and schedules it.

states.name: in_progress
states.label: In progress
states.description: Its assignee is doing the requested work.

states.name: delivered
states.label: Delivered
states.description: Its results are released back to the project that asked.

states.name: declined
states.label: Declined
states.description: The service won't do it, and says why.

guards.name: drawn
guards.message: Record the draw from the assigned source before receiving this sample.

guards.name: received
guards.message: Receive the sample before testing it.

guards.name: tested
guards.message: Record at least one measurement in testing before submitting for review.

signatures.label: Authorship
signatures.statement: I recorded these measurements as observed.

guards.name: submitted
guards.message: Review the signed submission.

guards.name: independent
guards.check:
last.status.in_review.by != actor.person && (last.status.retesting == null ?
 edits.status.pending + edits.status.received + edits.status.in_testing :
 edits.status.retesting).all(e, e.by != actor.person || !e.fields.exists(f, f in ["measurements", "notes"]))
guards.message: Someone other than the submitter and measurement editors must review this testing cycle.

signatures.label: Review
signatures.statement: I reviewed this record and found it in order.

guards.name: signed
guards.message: Return a submitted or reviewed sample to testing.

signatures.label: Responsibility
signatures.statement: I return these measurements to testing for the reason recorded.

guards.name: drawn
guards.message: Record the draw from the assigned source before receiving this sample.

guards.name: received
guards.message: Receive the sample before testing it.

states.name: done
states.label: Done
states.description: Used or measured. Return it to testing, with a reason, to correct it.

guards.name: started
guards.message: Receive the sample before completing it.

guards.name: done
guards.message: Return a completed sample to testing.

states.name: quarantined
states.label: Quarantined
states.description: Made or received, and not yet released or made available. It can be drawn from to be tested.

guards.name: reopened
guards.description: A released lot goes back to quarantine only to correct it, saying why.
guards.message: A lot goes back to quarantine from Released, Available, Due for retest or On hold.

states.name: released
states.label: Released
states.description: QA released it for use. Its values can't change while it's released.

guards.name: from_quarantine
guards.description: A lot is released from quarantine, once a hold is lifted, or once it's been retested.
guards.message: A lot is released from Quarantined, On hold or Due for retest.

guards.name: has_a_certificate
guards.description: QA releases a lot on its certificate of analysis.
guards.message: Attach its certificate of analysis before releasing it.

guards.name: says_where_it_came_from
guards.description: QA releases a lot knowing whether it was made or bought.
guards.message: Say whether it was made or bought before releasing it.

guards.name: names_its_maker
guards.description: A lot made in the lab names who made it, so QA can see it isn't releasing its own work.
guards.message: Say who made it before releasing it.

guards.name: not_its_maker
guards.description: Whoever made a lot doesn't release it; a second person checks it.
guards.message: You made this lot, so someone else in QA releases it.

guards.name: not_who_recorded_it
guards.description: Whoever recorded a lot made in the lab doesn't release it either: Iki knows who that was, whoever it says made it.
guards.message: You recorded this lot, so someone else in QA releases it.

guards.name: not_who_edited_it
guards.check: edits.disposition.quarantined.all(e, e.by != actor.person) && edits.disposition.retest_due.all(e, e.by != actor.person)
guards.message: You edited this lot's record, so someone else in QA releases it.

guards.name: a_person
guards.message: Release it yourself, in Iki, not through an app or agent.

signatures.label: QA release
signatures.statement: I release this lot for use: its records and certificate of analysis meet its specification.

states.name: available
states.label: Available
states.description: In use under the lab's own procedure, without a QA release or certificate: research material and consumables. It isn't Released, and its values stay editable.

guards.name: not_held_by_qa
guards.description: A stock keeper makes a lot available once it's received, or again after a hold put on it while it was available. A hold on a released or retested lot is lifted by QA.
guards.message: A lot is made available from Quarantined, or from On hold when it was available before. QA lifts its own holds.

states.name: retest_due
states.label: Due for retest
states.description: Past its retest date, and not expired: only QA sampling, until QA releases it again on its retest or it expires.

guards.name: past_its_retest_date
guards.message: Its retest date hasn't come.

guards.name: in_use
guards.message: A released or available lot comes due for retest.

states.name: on_hold
states.label: On hold
states.description: Kept from use while something is looked into, such as a deviation or a result out of its specification.

guards.name: not_rejected
guards.message: A rejected or expired lot isn't put on hold.

states.name: rejected
states.label: Rejected
states.description: It doesn't meet its specification. It's kept, with its records, but not used.

signatures.label: QA rejection
signatures.statement: I reject this lot; it isn't to be used.

states.name: expired
states.label: Expired
states.description: Past its expiry date, or past its retest date where the lab's procedure expires it then rather than marking it Due for retest. It's kept, but not used.

guards.name: past_its_date
guards.description: A lot expires once its expiry or retest date has come.
guards.check: (record.expires_on != null && record.expires_on <= today) || (record.retest_on != null && record.retest_on <= today)
guards.message: Its expiry and retest dates haven't come, so it hasn't expired.

guards.name: recorded_fit
guards.check: state.from == "recorded" && record.review_flow == "research" && record.fit_status != null && record.fit_version != null
guards.message: Sign the recorded fit produced under the research review flow.

signatures.label: Review
signatures.statement: I checked the measurements, exclusions and reported fit.

guards.name: correctable
guards.message: Return a submitted or reviewed result for correction.

guards.name: recorded_fit
guards.check: state.from == "recorded" && record.review_flow == "regulated_qc" && record.fit_status != null && record.fit_version != null
guards.message: Submit a recorded fit produced under the regulated QC flow.

signatures.label: Authorship
signatures.statement: I made this record, and what it says is accurate and complete.

guards.name: submitted
guards.message: Review the analyst's signed submission.

guards.name: independent
guards.check: history.review[0].by != actor.person && last.review.submitted.by != actor.person && edits.review.recorded.all(e, e.by != actor.person)
guards.message: A reviewer independent of the creator, submitter and editors must sign.

signatures.label: Review
signatures.statement: I reviewed this record and found it in order.

guards.name: reviewed
guards.message: QA releases an independently reviewed submission.

guards.name: independent
guards.check: history.review[0].by != actor.person && last.review.submitted.by != actor.person && last.review.reviewed.by != actor.person && edits.review.recorded.all(e, e.by != actor.person)
guards.message: QA release requires a signer independent of the analyst, reviewer and editors.

signatures.label: QA release
signatures.statement: I approve this record.

guards.name: correction
guards.message: Only a submission awaiting independent review or QA release can be corrected.

guards.name: research
guards.check: state.from == "recorded" && record.review_flow == "research" && record.pull_revision != null && record.report != null
guards.message: Sign the recorded research measurement from a completed pull after attaching its report.

signatures.label: Review
signatures.statement: I checked the stability measurement and its report.

guards.name: qc
guards.check: state.from == "recorded" && record.review_flow == "regulated_qc" && record.pull_revision != null && record.report != null
guards.message: Submit the recorded QC measurement from a completed pull after attaching its report.

signatures.label: Authorship
signatures.statement: I recorded the stability measurement as observed.

guards.name: submitted
guards.message: Review the analyst's signed submission.

guards.name: independent
guards.check: history.review[0].by != actor.person && last.review.submitted.by != actor.person && edits.review.recorded.all(e, e.by != actor.person)
guards.message: Someone independent of the creator, submitter and editors must review.

signatures.label: Review
signatures.statement: I reviewed this record and found it in order.

guards.name: reviewed
guards.message: QA releases an independently reviewed submission.

guards.name: independent
guards.check: history.review[0].by != actor.person && last.review.submitted.by != actor.person && last.review.reviewed.by != actor.person && edits.review.recorded.all(e, e.by != actor.person)
guards.message: Release requires a signer independent of the analyst, reviewer and editors.

signatures.label: QA release
signatures.statement: I approve this record.

guards.name: correctable
guards.message: Only a submission awaiting review or release can be returned for correction.

guards.name: author_signed
guards.message: Capture the evidence with the author sign-off flow before signing this record.

guards.name: author
guards.description: The authorship signature is the signer's own record, not a colleague's.
guards.message: Only the person who created or edited this record signs it as its author.

guards.name: closed
guards.message: The experiment changed since its evidence was captured. Capture it again before signing.

guards.name: cited_exactly
guards.description: A notebook entry or protocol isn't needed, but one that's cited names its revision.
guards.check: ((record.eln_id == null && record.eln_url == null) || record.eln_revision != null) && (record.protocol_id == null || record.protocol_revision != null)
guards.message: Give the revision of the notebook entry or protocol this record cites.

guards.name: evidence
guards.message: Capture a result, record a dated observation or attach evidence before signing.

signatures.statement: I recorded this experiment and checked the evidence it cites.

guards.message: Capture the evidence with the research review flow before witnessing this record.

guards.name: notebook
guards.message: Record the ELN entry URL or ID and its exact revision.

guards.name: protocol
guards.message: Identify the protocol followed and its revision.

guards.name: evidence
guards.message: Capture a result, record a dated observation or attach evidence before signing.

guards.name: independent
guards.message: The creator or a person who edited this record cannot witness it.

signatures.label: Witness
signatures.statement: I witnessed the experiment record and checked the cited notebook version and evidence.

guards.message: Capture the evidence with the regulated QC flow before submitting this experiment.

guards.message: Record the ELN entry URL or ID and its exact revision.

guards.name: protocol
guards.message: Identify the protocol followed and its revision.

guards.name: evidence
guards.message: Capture a result, record a dated observation or attach evidence before signing.

signatures.label: Authorship

guards.message: Someone independent of the creator, submitter and current cycle's editors must review this experiment.

signatures.label: Review
signatures.statement: I reviewed this record and found it in order.

guards.name: independent
guards.check: history.review[0].by != actor.person && last.review.submitted.by != actor.person && last.review.reviewed.by != actor.person && edits.review.recorded.all(e, e.by != actor.person)
guards.message: QA release requires a person independent of the creator, submitter, reviewer and current cycle's editors.
